name: EZ Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
aliases: Standing EZ Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and press an EZ bar straight overhead using a narrow overhand grip on the inner bends.
Brace your core, keep your ribs tucked down, and position your upper arms close to your ears.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head while your upper arms remain steady.
Squeeze your triceps to extend your elbows and drive the bar smoothly back overhead.
tips: Avoid overarching your lower back or thrusting your hips forward as the bar drops behind your head.
Keep your elbows pointing upward rather than flaring wide to the sides.
